name: search-failover
description: Web search with automatic failover across Bocha/Tavily/Brave/Exa/SearXNG/DuckDuckGo, opt-in Zhipu/Qianfan/Serper. Works with zero API keys (DuckDuckGo fallback).

ZHIPU_API_KEY.title: Zhipu 智谱 API key
ZHIPU_API_KEY.description: Optional. Opt-in provider: also list it in Providers.

QIANFAN_API_KEY.title: Baidu Qianfan 百度千帆 API key
QIANFAN_API_KEY.description: Optional. Opt-in provider: also list it in Providers.

SERPER_API_KEY.title: Serper API key
SERPER_API_KEY.description: Optional. Opt-in provider: also list it in Providers.

SEARXNG_URL.title: SearXNG (self-hosted) URL
SEARXNG_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of your instance, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (enable the json format in its settings).

PROVIDERS.title: Providers
PROVIDERS.description: Optional. Provider chain in priority order, e.g. tavily,brave,duckduckgo. Leave empty for the default chain.

CONFIG_PATH.title: Config file path
CONFIG_PATH.description: Optional. Absolute path to a config file. Defaults to ~/.config/search-failover/config.json.
